evidence: The Si(100) samples were first cleaned in 48% HF/ethanol to remove the native oxide. The samples were then rinsed with ethanol and blown free of particles before mounting. After sample introduction in the deposition chamber, the surface of the Si(100) samples was cleaned with a 27 Pa, 2 min H2O plasma at 300 K. This H2O plasma also oxidizes the Si(100) sample and leaves the SiO2 surface completely hydroxylated.
